title: Formalizations of theorems related to model checking
abstract: Proves that every linear temporal logic formula has an equivalent finite-state nondeterministic Büchi automaton (via negation normal form, alternating Büchi automata, and the Miyano-Hayashi breakpoint construction), and that every linear-time property decomposes as the intersection of a safety property and a liveness property.

informal.LeanModelChecking.for_any_LTL_formula_ex: For any linear temporal logic formula there exists an equivalent finite-state nondeterministic Büchi automaton, i.e. one whose state type is finite, accepting the same language.
informal.LeanModelChecking.LTL: The syntax of linear temporal logic formulas over a set of atomic propositions.
informal.LeanModelChecking.NBW: A nondeterministic Büchi automaton over a given alphabet of letters.
informal.LeanModelChecking.ABW.toNBW.lang_eq: The Miyano-Hayashi breakpoint construction turns any alternating Büchi automaton over a finite state space into a nondeterministic Büchi automaton accepting the same language.
informal.SafetyLivenessDecomposition.safety_liven: Every linear-time property is the intersection of a safety property and a liveness property.
